description: This file defines the DeviceRepository class for managing device data within a MongoDB collection, including CRUD operations, validation, and indexing.

classes.name: DeviceRepository
classes.description: Encapsulates CRUD operations and validation for device data stored in MongoDB.

methods.name: __init__(self, mongo_uri: str, db_name: str, collection_name: str)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with MongoDB connection and sets up indexing.

methods.name: Optional[str] validate_device_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any], require_name: bool = True)
methods.description: Validates the device data payload, checking required fields and IP address format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_devices(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all devices from the database, sorted by name.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_device(self, device: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a new device into the database, raising an error on duplicate names.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_device(self, name: str, update: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates existing device data by name.

methods.name: bool delete_device(self, name: str)
methods.description: Deletes a device entry by name.
